title: Extend misroute guard to all auto-committing write tools
context: Issue #62 identified that the worktree misrouting guard was only protecting hunch_record_decision, leaving hunch_record_correction and hunch_record_finding exposed to the same errors. Touches invariant(s): con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Unified the misroute guard via a shared misrouteGuard mechanism that checks file evidence (related_files, scope_hint_file, affected_files) across all auto-committing write tools, eliminating the inconsistency.
consequences: hunch_record_correction and hunch_record_finding now have the same new/untracked file detection protection as hunch_record_decision
Guard checks are now consistent across tools, reducing the attack surface for worktree misroutes
The modified-tracked-file detection gap remains unresolved (known open issue in #75, not #62 -- #62 covered the tool-coverage extension only and closes with this work)
alternatives_rejected: Fixing each tool individually without centralizing the guard logic
Solving the modified-tracked-file gap simultaneously in this commit
